propositions: Current clarity measure rewards volume and legacy shape rather than author-guide leaf/container contracts, allowing padded tickets to pass without Approach, grounded Scope, or per-criterion verification.
Clarity score is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py with inconsistent bug-branch handling, inviting drift on maintenance.

Deterministic per-AC verification coverage can be mechanically checked by parsing wrapped checkboxes for operator attestation or explicit proving clauses, enabling advisory advisory coverage reporting.
Placeholder-free scope/approach detection should flag guide-lexicon terms (TBD, figure out, depends on investigation, etc.) case-insensitively as deferred decisions that cap clarity.

Structural shape requirements should be keyed on graph altitude (leaf vs. container) rather than ticket type, with required nonempty sections (Context/Problem + AC for all; Approach + Scope for leaves; graph-backed child decomposition for containers).

Author-guide and criterion-guide documentation diverge on Success Criteria (inert in tests, collapsed into AC in epic 1386) and rejected-alternative requirement (guide requires naming; G6 forbids requirement); clarity checks should defer both to active resolution (bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82).
